signature: parseRange(size: number, str: string, options?: {combine?: unknown}): Array<{start: number, end: number}> | -1 | -2
error_contract: throws TypeError('argument str must be a string') for non-string str; returns -2 for malformed headers and -1 for headers with no satisfiable range
determinism: same inputs produce the same array order, range values, type property, and sentinel result
